name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMS)
description: Central scheme supporting meritorious students from economically weaker sections to prevent dropout after Class 8; selection via state-level Mental Ability Test and Scholastic Aptitude Test

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship (CSSS / PM-USP)
description: Central scholarship for meritorious college and university students scoring above the 80th percentile in Class 12 boards

name: PM-YASASVI Scholarship
description: Central scholarship for OBC EBC and DNT category students to support school education and reduce dropout
benefit: Up to ₹75,000 (Class 9-10) or ₹1.25 lakh (Class 11-12) per year

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girls
description: Scholarship for girl students admitted to AICTE-approved technical diploma or degree programmes; up to two girls per family may apply

name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
description: Central scheme covering tuition and maintenance costs for SC category students pursuing post-matriculation studies
benefit: Full tuition fee + maintenance allowance (varies by course/state)

name: National Fellowship for OBC Students
description: UGC fellowship supporting OBC candidates pursuing MPhil and PhD in Indian universities
benefit: Monthly fellowship + contingency grant (as per UGC norms)

name: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)
description: DST scheme for top-ranking students pursuing natural/basic science courses at undergraduate and integrated master's level

name: Kishore Vaigyanik Protsahan Yojana (KVPY/VIGYAN)
description: DST fellowship encouraging students to pursue basic science research careers

name: Karnataka Post Matric Scholarship (OBC)
description: State scheme for OBC category students from Karnataka pursuing post-matric education
benefit: Tuition + maintenance allowance as per state norms

name: Tamil Nadu First Graduate Scholarship
description: State scheme supporting the first graduate in a family to pursue higher education in Tamil Nadu
benefit: Monthly stipend as per state norms
